segments.sn2.9:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena candimā devaputto rāhunā asurindena gahito hoti.
segments.sn2.9:1.3: Atha kho candimā devaputto bhagavantaṃ anussaramāno tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi –
segments.sn2.9:3.1: Atha kho bhagavā candimaṃ devaputtaṃ ārabbha rāhuṃ asurindaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi –
segments.sn2.9:5.1: Atha kho rāhu asurindo candimaṃ devaputtaṃ muñcitvā taramānarūpo yena vepacitti asurindo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
segments.sn2.9:5.2: Ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho rāhuṃ asurindaṃ vepacitti asurindo gāthāya ajjhabhāsi –
segments.sn2.9:6.3: Saṃviggarūpo āgamma, kiṃ nu bhītova tiṭṭhasī”ti.
segments.sn2.9:7.1: “Sattadhā me phale muddhā, jīvanto na sukhaṃ labhe;

lines: Vimāne gahite taṃnivāsīpi gahito hotīti vuttaṃ “candavimānavāsī devaputto”ti.
Sabbadhīti sabbasmā duggaṭṭhānā vippamuttosi bhagavā tvaṃ, tasmā mayhampi ito sambādhaṭṭhānato vippamokkhaṃ karohīti adhippāyo.
Lokānukampakāti sabbassa lokassa anuggahā, tasmā tuyhampi etassapi candassa.
